en-US.title: Crapple Maps
en-US.subtitle: Find a bathroom, fast
en-US.description:
You know the feeling. Crapple Maps finds the nearest public restroom before it becomes a problem.

A community-built map of nearly 100,000 restrooms — with the details that actually matter when you're in a hurry.

FIND ONE NOW
• Nearest restrooms sorted by distance, with walking directions one tap away
• See at a glance whether it's public, customers-only, needs a door code, or requires a purchase
• Colored symbols for wheelchair access, gender-neutral, and changing tables
• Filter for exactly what you need, then search any address or city to plan ahead

THE DETAILS THAT SAVE YOU
• Door codes shared by people who've been there
• "How to find it" directions for the restroom hidden behind the unmarked door
• Ratings and reviews from the community

ADD TO THE MAP
Found one that isn't listed? Add it in seconds and help the next person. Fix wrong info, share a door code, or drop a note about the tricky entrance.

KEEP A LOG (IF YOU WANT)
Track your visits privately, or share them with friends you follow. Rate the experience, add a photo, log the Bristol scale if that's your thing. Every log is private by default — you choose what to share.

Crapple Maps is free, works in light and dark mode, and never sells your data.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release. Find nearby restrooms, see access and amenities at a glance, get door codes from the community, and add the ones we're missing.
en-US.promoText: The nearest restroom, with the door code, before you need it.

review.notes: Location permission drives the core feature — please allow it so nearby restrooms populate.
